en:
It's already nighttime, Shuichi. What are
you doing out and about at this hour?
I...promised to meet up with Maki.
...I see.

Well, I have no intention of strictly upholding
a curfew...

Perhaps it's an old habit from my time on the
student council, but I felt like I had to ask.
That was only a few days ago.

It feels like we formed the student council
with Angie ages ago...

<CLT=cltMIND>...A lot of things have happened since
then. We haven't had a moment to relax.
At any rate, please be careful.

Being out during nighttime could result in
another murder.

Especially now, when we don't know
Kokichi's whereabouts.
You're right. I'll be careful.

It feels like we formed the student council
with Angie ages ago...

Tsumugi? What are you looking
up at the sky for?

Oh, Shuichi. I was...just looking at 
the stars a little.
I remembered...something Gonta said before.
What did Gonta say?
Remember...? After Kirumi's trial...
<CLT=cltMIND>Now that she mentions it...

What's wrong, Gonta?
Why're you staring up at the sky?

It's just...even when all this bad stuff
happens, stars are always so pretty.

But stars here different.
Not the same ones Gonta used to.

I was just thinking...the stars 
really are pretty.

I can't tell the difference, since I don't 
usually look at them, but...they're pretty.
I'd forgotten this feeling...

With all the horrible things happening...
I was always looking down...
...I need to thank Gonta.
You're right.
Hey, do you want to join me, Shuichi?

Ah, sorry, there's...something
I have to take care of...

I see. Well, I'm going to stay here 
a little while longer.

I'll be here for a little while longer 
watching the stars...
